description: Inspect a domain's DNSSEC chain from the root down: DS and DNSKEY records per zone, whether each DS matches a published key, signature expiry, and whether validating resolvers (Cloudflare, Google) treat the domain as secure, insecure or bogus. Signatures are judged by those resolvers, not recomputed.
name: dnssec_check
title: DNSSEC chain validation
